summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a UK Regulatory Information Service announcement) disclosing a PDMR share purchase under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Independent Non-Executive Director Bláthnaid Bergin bought 7,670 ordinary shares (ISIN GB00BMX86B70) at £3.242 per share on 30 October 2026 on the London Stock Exchange, notified to the company that day and reported 2 November 2026. The transaction is a routine single-trade director dealing disclosure; no board recommendation, advisor, offer mechanics, ownership shift or regulatory clock arises. No special-situation angle; watch only for further PDMR dealings.
